answer: The yarrow counter is kept in comet and inlet publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An farming party thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 98 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
